info.name: Microsoft Azure AccessControlClient AccessConnector Glossary API
Glossary
Microsoft Azure Get Atlas Glossary

params.name: limit
params.description: The page size - by default there is no paging.

params.name: offset
params.description: The offset for pagination purpose.

params.name: sort
params.description: The sort order, ASC (default) or DESC.

params.name: ignoreTermsAndCategories
params.description: Whether ignore terms and categories

items.docs: Get all glossaries registered with Atlas. Recommend using limit/offset to get pagination result. Recommended using 'ignoreTermsAndCategories=true' and fetch terms/categories separately using 'GET /catalog/api/atlas/v2/glossary/{glossaryGuid}/terms' and 'GET '/catalog/api/atlas/v2/glossary/{glossaryGuid}/categories'.
